title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
text:
Location: Hyderabad
Team: Engineering - Design

At Sonatype, we empower software development teams with cutting-edge solutions that enhance software supply chain security and streamline development processes. Our tools are trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, and we are on a mission to make software development faster and more secure.
As a remote-first company, we foster an environment of collaboration, innovation, and professional growth. Join us in shaping the future of secure software development!

Role Summary
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team in India. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing scalable applications across the entire software stack. As a senior engineer, you will contribute to technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural decisions, helping to drive innovation and efficiency in our engineering processes.

What you will do
-
Architect, develop, and optimize full-stack applications with modern web technologies.

-
Lead the design and implementation of scalable microservices, APIs, and cloud-based solutions .

-
Develop and maintain front-end applications using ensuring a seamless user experience.

-
Build robust backend services using Java integrating with databases and external systems.

-
Drive best practices in software engineering , including code reviews, design patterns, and scalable architectures.

-
Work with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and AWS cloud platform.

-
Optimize database performance with relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) solutions.

-
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and DevOps, to deliver high-quality software.

-
Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and innovation.

-
Ensure high availability, security, and performance of applications through proactive monitoring and testing.

-
Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines , development workflows, and automation strategies.

Required Skills
-
5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer, with a focus on scalable web applications.

-
Deep experience with backend development using Java .

-
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and front-end frameworks ( React ).

-
Expertise in building RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures .

-
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms - AWS and serverless computing .

-
Strong knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) .

-
Familiarity with secure coding practices and software supply chain security principles

Preferred Skills
-
A track record of technical leadership in driving projects and mentoring engineers.

-
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a remote-first, agile environment .

-
A passion for open-source technologies and a drive to stay ahead of industry trends.

Why Join Sonatype?
✅ Work on cutting-edge software supply chain security solutions.
✅ Competitive salary & benefits package.
✅ Opportunities for career growth & leadership in a high-impact role.
✅ Collaborative, diverse, and innovation-driven work environment.
✅ Continuous learning through training programs, conferences, and mentorship.
